title.en: European Commission Designates ChatGPT as Very Large Online Search Engine Under DSA
title.zhHans: 欧盟委员会根据《数字服务法》将 ChatGPT 指定为超大型在线搜索引擎 (VLOSE)

searchSummary.en: The European Commission designated ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine under the DSA on August 31, 2026. Additional VLOSE obligations are due within four months of notification.
searchSummary.zhHans: 欧盟委员会于 2026 年 8 月 31 日根据《数字服务法》将 ChatGPT 指定为超大型在线搜索引擎。额外 VLOSE 义务应在收到通知后四个月内履行。

summary.en: The European Commission designated ChatGPT as a Very Large Online Search Engine (VLOSE) under the Digital Services Act on August 31, 2026. The Commission says the service declared at least 45 million average monthly EU users. Following notification, OpenAI has four months to meet additional DSA obligations, including systemic-risk assessment and mitigation. The event concerns a DSA designation, not classification under the EU AI Act.
summary.zhHans: 欧盟委员会于 2026 年 8 月 31 日根据《数字服务法》（DSA）将 ChatGPT 指定为超大型在线搜索引擎（VLOSE）。欧委会称该服务申报在欧盟拥有至少 4,500 万平均月用户。收到通知后，OpenAI 有四个月履行额外 DSA 义务，包括系统性风险评估与缓解。该事件是 DSA 指定，而非欧盟《人工智能法案》下的分类。

narrative.en: The Commission made the designation alongside VLOP designations for Reddit and Roblox. Its notice says the additional obligations apply after notification and covers risks related to illegal content, minors, well-being, fundamental rights, elections, and public security. EpochArc uses the Commission's more durable formulation—within four months of notification—rather than inferring an exact operational date from differing media phrasing. The decision applies to ChatGPT as designated; it does not establish an automatic rule that every conversational model above a user threshold is a search engine.
narrative.zhHans: 欧委会同时将 Reddit 与 Roblox 指定为 VLOP。其公告称，额外义务在通知后适用，涉及非法内容、未成年人、身心健康、基本权利、选举及公共安全等风险。EpochArc 使用欧委会更稳健的表述——收到通知后四个月内——而不从媒体的不同措辞推断精确操作日期。该决定适用于被指定的 ChatGPT，并不构成“所有达到用户门槛的对话模型都会自动成为搜索引擎”的规则。

description.en: Requires additional DSA compliance work after notification, including systemic-risk assessment and mitigation, with enforcement consequences defined by the DSA.
description.zhHans: 通知后将需要承担额外 DSA 合规工作，包括系统性风险评估与缓解，其执法后果由 DSA 确定。

description.en: Provides a concrete case of a generative-AI service being designated under the DSA's search-engine regime; implications for similar services remain open.
description.zhHans: 提供了生成式 AI 服务被纳入 DSA 搜索引擎监管体系的具体案例；对类似服务的影响仍有待观察。

text.en: The European Commission designated ChatGPT a VLOSE under the DSA on August 31, 2026 and stated that additional obligations are due within four months of notification.
text.zhHans: 欧盟委员会于 2026 年 8 月 31 日将 ChatGPT 指定为 DSA 下的 VLOSE，并表示额外义务应在收到通知后四个月内履行。

text.en: The Commission lists systemic-risk assessment and mitigation among the additional DSA obligations for this designation.
text.zhHans: 欧委会将系统性风险评估与缓解列为该指定下的额外 DSA 义务之一。

text.en: The designation is specific to ChatGPT and its notification; it is not an automatic legal classification for all conversational AI services above the user threshold.
text.zhHans: 该指定针对 ChatGPT 及其通知情形，并非对所有超过用户门槛的对话式 AI 服务自动作出的法律分类。

editorial.reviewNotes: Reviewed against the Commission notice; compliance timing and scope are expressed as notified, service-specific obligations.
